item.title: Amai Toki ~Sweet Time~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: P-Factory
  • 発売日: 2010-02-26
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 甘い刻 ～SWEET TIME～
  • 英語名: Amai Toki Sweet Time

あらすじ

In his dreams, Ryou sees a beautiful girl dressed in traditional clothes crying in an old fashioned courtyard and there is nothing he could do. Also, the girl looks very similar to the new apprentice teacher Megumi. Is this a scene from his past life? Will they be able to fulfill her feelings from the past?

item.title: Ano Machi no Koi no Uta
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: P-Factory
  • 発売日: 2006-03-31
  • スコア: 5.74/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あの街の恋の詩
  • 英語名: Ano Machi no Koi no Uta

あらすじ

Kyohei lives an ordinary life doing nothing special, just enjoying his life with his friends. He gets involved in an accident at a big festival taken place once a year. His ordinary life changes to an extraordinary life since then. This is a love story with four girls until they get away from this extraordinary life.
